instruction: Create `/home/user/Desktop/qfn8.lbr`, an EAGLE library containing exactly one package, and save it. Requirements: 1. The file must parse as XML. 2. The library must contain exactly one `<package>` named `QFN-8-0.5`. 3. The package must contain exactly eight `<smd>` pads numbered `1` through `8`. 4. The pad geometry must match a 5 x 5 mm QFN-8 outline with 0.5 mm pitch and 0.25 x 0.6 mm pads. The package may be translated from the origin, but the pad coordinates relative to their common center and their pin numbering must preserve this geometry. 5. The package must contain a layer 21 silkscreen outline and pin-1 marker. 6. The package must also contain `>NAME` and `>VALUE` text on layers `25` and `27`. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
